King of Fighters, The - Evolution.name: The King of Fighters: Evolution
King of Fighters, The - Evolution.summary: King of Fighters '99 was remade for the Dreamcast as The King of Fighters: Evolution. In this port, players can change the audio to listen to arranged tracks of the soundtrack. The Dreamcast port also had the stages completed remodeled in 3D.

NFL 2K2.name: NFL 2K2
NFL 2K2.summary:
NFL 2K2 is a complete football simulation, giving you a variety of ways to play. You can compete in a single exhibition game, start up a franchise, or move directly to the playoffs.

NFL 2K2 uses a TV-style presentation, featuring telestration, action replays, sideline animations, stadium lighting and a director feature that zooms in on the play.

Included in NFL 2K2 are all the teams and plays from the 2001-2002 season, including stadiums and uniforms.

Nobunaga no Yabou - Reppuuden.name: Nobunaga's Ambition: Reppuden
Nobunaga no Yabou - Reppuuden.summary: The eighth title in the Nobunaga's Ambition series.

Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni - Ope.name: Tsuki ha Higashi ni Hi ha Nishi ni: Operation Sanctuary
Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni - Ope.summary: Naoki Kazumi is a boy whose parents died in an accident five years ago, and his memory went along with it. Since he had nowhere else to go, he lives with his cousin Matsuri Shibugaki and her parents. Every morning before school, he is awakened by his childhood friend, Honami Fujieda, who keeps telling him that he is not a child anymore, but still comes to wake him up. These usual, ordinary days seem to stretch on forever, until one day up on the school's rooftop, while Naoki is taking a peaceful nap, out of nowhere, a girl falls out of the sky. This girl, called Mikoto Amagasaki, comes from 100 years in the future, and she went back in time with the intention of finding her brother. When Mikoto sees Naoki, she mistakes him for her brother.
